title: Lost Your Job? Don’t Do This.
description:
Lost your job or got laid off? Before you start applying everywhere, stop.

Most job seekers panic-apply and waste weeks. There’s a smarter way.

Watch the full video where I break down the 5-day job search plan that actually helps you land interviews faster 

https://youtu.be/BtjMNlVmaUI?si=xn4o3VCwVE_B8QUS

#JobSearch #LaidOff #CareerAdvice #ResumeTips #JobSearchStrategy
transcript: If I lost my job tomorrow, I would not apply to a single job for five full days. I know that sounds wrong because most people think moving faster gets you hired faster, but it doesn't. Rushing is how people waste weeks. Strategy is what actually speeds things up. So, here is the order I'd follow. First, I'd get clear. I'd pull my wins, my impact, and ask one question. How do I actually solve a problem for the roles I want? Because companies don't hire effort, they hire solutions. Second, I'd stop thinking like a job seeker and start thinking like a hiring manager. I'd study a few target roles to figure out what's broken, what needs fixing, and where my experience fits. Third, I'd focus on visibility, updating my LinkedIn, talking to real humans, and getting in front of recruiters and hiring managers. Because one real conversation beats 50 cold applications. And only then would I apply. Not everything, five to 10 targeted roles a week. If you want the full five-day plan, watch the long video linked to you and follow for more job search strategy that actually works.
